messages:
maria: Quick sync — follow-up from the 2026-03-10 incident (missing spans + bad aggregation). Need owners and short timelines so this doesn't linger. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
kevin: I'll own the aggregator join fix (null service_id caused the partial-match). Plan: PR with fix + unit tests, staged rollout. ETA 7 business days.
ella: I'll take the backfill orchestration and safety limits. Plan: dry-run on snapshot, then rate-limited backfill jobs (`max_window=72h`). ETA dry-run 2d, phased backfill 8d.
ajay: I'll add a CI regression test that fails if rollup totals deviate >10% from raw spans on a synthetic dataset. ETA 3d.
sam: Ops: add a recurring coverage sweep every 6 hours to surface drift earlier. Cron: `0 */6 * * *`. Alert if coverage drops >15% vs 24h baseline.
kevin: I'll also include a migration to default safe service_id to avoid null-join cases; will coordinate with DB team for a low-impact window.
infra-bot: NOTE: similar symptoms recorded 2025-10-12 and 2026-01-05. Recurring pattern flagged. Suggested quarterly audit.
maria: Owners summary: kevin=aggregator fix (7d), ella=backfill (2d dry-run / 8d phased), ajay=CI test (3d), sam=ops job+alert (1d), maria=update postmortem & remediation tracker (1d). Confirm?
ajay: confirm. I'll push the CI changes and add the synthetic dataset.
kevin: confirm. PR will include before/after metrics and a rollback gate.
ella: confirm. I'll create `infra.spans.backfill.v3` with `--dry-run` and throttling flags.
sam: ops note: add post-deploy smoke to assert top-10 services' rollup counts >= 85% expected over last 1h; failure triggers rollback + page.
maria: I'll add a quarterly calendar event "aggregator assumptions audit" and own the checklist. Also updating postmortem with owners, timelines, and SQL snippets for the runbook.
kevin: will tag @maria in PR and request rollout approval when staging looks good.
maria: thanks team. I'll open a remediation ticket and set weekly check-ins until everything's closed. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
